payments.title: Report payments from your server
payments.description: Call the LevelUp API from your server on every payment change, whatever your payment provider: typically in its webhook or notification handler, after verifying its signature, or from your own order system for bank transfers and cash on delivery.
payments.publicKeyHint: Sent in the apikey header. It is public: the server key in the body is what authenticates your website.
payments.serverKeyHint: Sent in the body as p_key. Create one in the Server keys tab and keep it in LEVELUP_SITE_KEY on your server.
payments.envHint: Add these to your server’s environment, never to browser code.
payments.contractDescription: The body has two fields, p_key and p_event. The key picks the website: an event cannot name one.

fields.provider: Your payment provider: one of the slugs below (lowercase), or "other".
fields.provider_event_id: Unique id of this notification (letters, digits, _ . : @ / + = | # -, up to 255). The same event twice is ignored. No event id at your provider? Use payment id + status.
fields.provider_payment_id: The provider's payment, session or transaction id. One payment per id and provider.
fields.provider_reference: A second id (payment intent, your tx_ref, operator id…) or null.
fields.method: card, mobile_money, bank_transfer, paypal, cash, other, or null.
fields.status: paid, pending, failed, refunded, expired or cancelled.
fields.amount: Integer in the currency's minor unit: 2500 = 25.00 USD, 15000 = 15 000 XOF.
fields.currency: ISO 4217 code (USD, XOF, NGN…), any case.
fields.customer: An object with email and name, or null: valid email, name up to 120 characters, no HTML, no other key.
fields.offer: An object with id and name, or null: your product id (letters, digits, _ . : -), name up to 200 characters.
fields.livemode: true or false (optional). A live key refuses a payment marked false; a test key records test payments.
fields.occurred_at: ISO 8601 date with a time zone.
fields.metadata: JSON object up to 8 KB, or null.

payments.strict: Any other field, a wrong type (for example "amount": "260") or a value out of range is refused.

responses.22023: Invalid event; the message names the field
responses.duplicate: Already received (duplicate: true), safe to ignore
responses.PT429: More than 300 calls in 10 minutes for this key

payments.statusRule: A payment never goes back from paid to pending, failed or cancelled: a late event answers 200 with applied: false, so your webhook does not retry. Refunded, expired and cancelled are final.
payments.testMode: Use a lu_test_ key with your provider's test or sandbox mode. Test payments are hidden by default on the Payments page.
payments.exampleDescription: Copy lib/levelup.ts once, then the handler of your provider. Each one verifies the provider's signature (or reads the payment back from it) before reporting.
payments.providersDescription: Send the slug in provider. Not listed? Use other and put its name in metadata.
payments.aliasesDescription: Integrations written for the first version keep working: these names are still accepted. Send one or the other, not both.
payments.amountsDescription: Convert the provider's amount to the currency's ISO 4217 minor unit before sending it.
payments.amountsHint: Stripe and Paystack already send minor units; PayPal, Flutterwave and CinetPay send major units (use toMinor below). The Payments page shows each currency with its own decimals.

examples.stripe: Checkout session events and refunds. Stripe amounts are already in minor units.
examples.paypal: Captures (Orders v2). The signature is checked by PayPal's verify endpoint; amounts like "10.00" are converted.
examples.flutterwave: charge.completed, re-read from the verify endpoint. Amounts are in major units.
examples.paystack: charge.success with the HMAC SHA-512 signature. Amounts are already in the subunit.
examples.cinetpay: Your notify_url: the status is read back from the check API. XOF and XAF have no minor unit.
examples.generic: Any other provider or your own orders: build the event from what you know.
